_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate favors HOLD; no single breaker (ETF rebound or fear/greed break) is confirmed, so stay on the Complacency rung.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on crypto forward phase and describes cross-asset energy/metals flow instead
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound with fear/greed ~50-60 and funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with momentum break higher, or crowded longs unwind and fear/greed drops through the low 40s
